name: BatchRecordReviewReleaseConsole
tagline: GMP batch disposition in one control – review by exception, release gates and four-eyes QP certification.
description: A complete batch record review and release app for Power Apps and Power Pages. QA sees every batch from documents received to certification on a dashboard, a drag-and-drop review board, a batch list and a release plan. Deviations, OOS/OOT results, change controls, yield limits, remaining shelf life and the review checklist gate the release; the certification dialog enforces the four-eyes rule and records conditional-release justifications.
features: Disposition flow with allowed transitions and locked final states
Release gates for deviations, OOS/OOT, change controls, expiry and checklist
Bulk start review, assign, mark ready, export
Release KPIs: lead time, on-time %, blocked, overdue
